steps.en: Public portal accepts hirer or driver details only at set stages
steps.id: Portal publik hanya menerima data hirer atau driver di stage tertentu

steps.en: Staff portal accepts hirer or driver details only at set stages
steps.id: Portal staff hanya menerima data hirer atau driver di stage tertentu

steps.en: The allowed stages can differ for each notice type
steps.id: Stage yang diizinkan bisa berbeda untuk tiap notice type
steps.why_en: One stage list serves every notice type; only one type is blocked outright from online furnishing.
steps.why_id: Satu daftar stage berlaku untuk semua notice type; hanya satu type yang diblok total dari furnish online.

steps.en: Officer sets the allowed stages on a settings page
steps.id: Officer mengatur stage yang diizinkan di halaman pengaturan
steps.why_en: No settings page or stored setting exists; the stage lists are fixed in the program.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada halaman atau pengaturan tersimpan; daftar stage ditetapkan di program.

steps.en: Changing the allowed stages needs no software change
steps.id: Mengubah stage yang diizinkan tidak perlu perubahan software
steps.why_en: Each list is written into the program, so a change needs a new release.
steps.why_id: Tiap daftar tertulis di program, jadi perubahan butuh rilis baru.
